verdict.rationale: Kong's plugin architecture includes request/response transformation plugins (kong-gh-3) that let developers modify ('massage') request and response data, which partially supports the scripting/data-massaging part of the story. However, there is no evidence of an explicit scripting mechanism (e.g., pre-function/post-function or serverless script plugins) or of chaining multiple requests together in sequence. Missing for 10: documented custom-script (pre/post function) plugin capability, explicit request-chaining support, and independent confirmation of these features in practice.
